items.heading: Nshima with Ndiwo
details: Key ingredients: corn meal, water, leafy greens, dried fish
Cook corn meal with water into a thick, smooth dough (nshima).
Simmer leafy greens with tomato and onion.
Add dried fish or groundnuts to the greens.
Serve the nshima alongside the vegetable relish.

items.heading: Ifisashi
details: Key ingredients: leafy greens, groundnut paste, tomato
Simmer chopped leafy greens with tomato and onion.
Stir in ground peanut (groundnut) paste.
Cook until the sauce thickens and coats the greens.
Serve warm over nshima or rice.
